description: Test suite for command-related utility functions such as enablement checks, provider settings processing, and feature toggles, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the plugin registry before each test run, configuring test plugins for various providers.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for resolving native skills enabled, native commands enabled, command flag status, restart enabled, and explicit disable checks.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Specifies individual test cases for each utility function.
